pathAssistantSteps.info: Record the reason the opportunity was lost, such as pricing, competition, timing, or changing customer needs. Document feedback and identify lessons that may help future sales opportunities.
Confirm that the customer has agreed to purchase GoC's Training or Consulting services. Finalize the agreement, verify the Opportunity amount, and coordinate the handover for service delivery.
Discuss pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contract conditions with the customer. Resolve objections and reach an agreement that meets both parties' expectations.

Understand how the customer perceives GoC's Training or Consulting services and identify their expectations, concerns, and priorities. Explain how your services can solve their business challenges and build confidence in your proposed solution.

Prepare and present a detailed proposal that includes the scope of services, pricing, delivery timeline, and expected outcomes. Address the customer's questions, incorporate feedback, and agree on the next steps toward closing the deal.
